equipment_type: Kitchen hood demand control ventilation (DCV) controller (exhaust and make-up air fans)
applies_to: CaptiveAire demand control ventilation packages that run kitchen hood exhaust and supply (make-up air) fans, with the factory BACnet option.
summary: CaptiveAire DCV packages start and modulate kitchen hood exhaust and supply fans from temperature, occupancy, buttons, inputs or the BMS. BACnet IP or MS/TP comes from a factory-mounted Protocessor gateway in the electrical control panel, set at the factory for one of the two. The 231 objects are mostly read-only: 32 temperature sensors, zone and HMI readings, VFD frequency/current/power/fault for up to 8 exhaust and 2 supply fans, 'fans on by' and 'lights on by' reason flags, CORE fire-system fault codes, PCU filter monitoring and per-zone faults. Ten writable BVs carry the names of the panel's Prep Time, Fans On, Wash, Lights and Max Air buttons for two zones.
notes: Protocessor defaults: device instance 50000, MS/TP MAC 127, 38400 baud, Max Master 127, IP 192.168.1.24; COV is disabled by default.
Access comes from the guide's Function column: the ten button BVs (222-231) are Monitor/Control, everything else Monitor. The guide does not say what writing them does.
The guide does not expand KTS (BI 192/208); CaptiveAire's SCS panel manual (A0017476) uses KTS for its Kill Tamper Switch input.
ErrorCOREBoard1-15 (AI 132-146) report the highest-priority fault code (1-23) of each CORE fire-system board, Fire first.
Humidity, ECM and VDC outputs and the fault AIs are listed with no units.
Points depend on the package: unused sensors, fans, zones and PCUs read zero or are meaningless.

source.title: Direct Digital Controls (DDC) Application Guide: Demand Control Ventilation (DCV) Packages Network

integration.summary: Most DCV integrations are monitoring: map the zone temperatures, the fan VFD readings, the fans-on-by-BMS flags and the fire, fault and Modbus fault points. The only writable objects are the per-zone button BVs (Prep Time, Fans On, Wash, Lights, Max Air); the guide does not describe their behaviour, so test a write and watch the matching Zone-FansONbyBMS / LightsONbyBMS flags.

setup: Protocessor default device instance 50000, MS/TP MAC 127, 38400 baud, Max Master 127.
Protocessor default IP 192.168.1.24 /255.255.255.0; web configurator login admin/admin (or the password printed by the Ethernet port).
The gateway is factory set to either BACnet IP or MS/TP for the job; objects are only reachable on that port.
Each changed gateway parameter needs its own Submit and a system restart.
gotchas: COV is off by default (bac_cov_option = COV_Disable), so poll or enable COV.
The controller board reboots when some factory settings are changed.
ErrorCOREBoard AIs show only the highest-priority active fault; Fire wins over all others.
